reviewer: Optional read-only Luna/MAX leaf package_realism_scope; root owns decision
scope: Identify a useful optocoupler artwork refinement reachable on normal generated boards before editing
normalProducer: Rb56Plan.declarePower declares UFB as OPTOCOUPLER_4; Rb56PhysicalAssembly assigns its specification. No other normal generated-family producer found.
normalExclusion: PlayerFamilyCatalog.currentRegistration registers Rb56PlayerFamilyCapability with normalPlayerEnabled=false. GenerationCoordinator rejects disabled families before normal execution/publication; Rb56QualificationVerifier.requireHeldCatalog asserts disabled registration.
physicalAdmissionIsSeparate: MediumBoardNormalAdmission allows OPTOCOUPLER_4 under RB56_BOARD_NORMAL; that physical contract does not enable its normal-player catalog entry.
existingPaint: Shared installed/loose MultiTerminalRenderer draws leads, body/marking, then transformed reference dot. OptocouplerRenderer already has rounded body, upper highlight, lower shadow, OPTO text and pin-one dot.
detailConflict: Local body (90,25,160,140); left/right lead roots have centered 8x8 probe bounds. A center groove would cross the centered OPTO marking; edge detail risks lead/probe overlap.
decision: No production change. Do not enable RB56 for an artwork task. Review normal-player ambiguity instead of duplicating existing paint.
limits: Source inspection only. No optocoupler player run, image inspection, native/build gate, electrical, manufacturing, all-seed or performance claim.
